title: The active inference framework and social cognitive theory: Informing therapeutic approaches for medically unexplained symptoms
title_zh: 主动推理框架与社会认知理论：为医学无法解释症状的治疗方法提供依据
abstract: Persistent physical symptoms for which no medical explanation can be found affects hundreds of millions of people globally. The active inference framework from cognitive neuroscience, which describes the brain's capacity for adaptive learning, is now providing the explanatory power and evidence to understand the phenomenon of medically unexplained symptoms. The active inference framework calls for a reconsideration of the evidence approach for people with persistent physical symptoms. In this paper, I provide an overview of the active inference framework. I show how combining the active inference framework with learning theories from behavioural psychology, in particular, social cognitive theory, can inform an approach to recovery. I develop a "therapeutic domains approach" embedded within the social cognitive theoretical model of learning and the active inference framework to guide the selection of evidence-based strategies to support recovery. The approach allows for all the sensory inputs that can contribute to the formation of medically unexplained symptoms to be targeted, and would enable patient centred, tailored, multi-strategic therapeutic plans to be developed and adopted. I demonstrate how the therapeutic domains approach is consistent with, but builds on the biopsychosocial model, by articulating and integrating the behavioural underpinnings and explanatory power for how and why a multi-strategic, therapeutic domains based approach would provide a roadmap for recovery for people with medically unexplained symptoms.
abstract_zh: 全球有数亿人受持续性躯体症状所困扰，但无法找到医学解释。源于认知神经科学的主动推理框架描述了大脑的自适应学习能力，现在为理解医学无法解释症状现象提供了解释力和证据。该框架要求重新审视针对持续性躯体症状患者的循证方法。本文概述了主动推理框架，并展示了将该框架与行为心理学中的学习理论（尤其是社会认知理论）相结合如何为康复方法提供指导。我提出了一种“治疗领域方法”，嵌入于社会认知学习理论模型与主动推理框架之中，以指导基于证据的策略的选择，支持康复。该方法可针对所有可能导致医学无法解释症状形成的感觉输入，并能够制定和采用以患者为中心、量身定制、多策略的治疗方案。我展示了治疗领域方法与生物-心理-社会模式相一致，并在此基础上进一步阐述，说明行为基础和解释力如何说明一种基于治疗领域的多策略方法能为医学无法解释症状患者提供康复路线图。
